run_two_triangles_optimization: run the two triangles geometry optimization loop to match a target rendered image
run_rasterize_vertices: run rasterize to convert vertex positions and indices into a per-pixel triangle index image
run_render_barycentric: run render to compute barycentric coordinates from vertex positions and an index image
run_interpolate_attributes: run interpolate to sample vertex attributes across pixels using barycentric coordinates
run_edge_grad_estimator: run edge_grad_estimator to compute differentiable edge gradients for geometry optimization
